arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'booking', b.booking_id, json_object('request_id',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'confirmed_at',b.confirmed_at,'hold',(SELECT json_object('flight',h.flight_id,'passenger',h.passenger_id) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status!='delivered'

SELECT b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.status,b.client_reference,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.amount_cents,c.created_step,e.kind AS customer_event,e.step AS event_step FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='pending' OR e.event_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'customer_event' AS kind, event_id AS id, json_object('request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) AS data FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',c.charge_id,json_object('booking',c.booking_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'log',CAST(id AS TEXT),json_object('service',service,'path',path,'status',status,'message',message) FROM request_logs WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM request_logs WHERE service='payment' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 16)

SELECT 'event' AS kind,event_id AS id,json_object('request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) AS data FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status!='delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'refund',refund_id,json_object('charge',charge_id,'booking',booking_id,'amount',amount_cents) FROM refunds

SELECT 'event' AS kind,event_id AS id,json_object('request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) AS data FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',c.charge_id,json_object('booking',c.booking_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'payment_log',CAST(id AS TEXT),json_object('path',path,'status',status,'message',message) FROM request_logs WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM request_logs WHERE service='payment' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 16)

SELECT b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.status,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.amount_cents,e.kind AS customer_event,e.step AS event_step FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='pending' OR e.event_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'booking_status' AS check_name, json_group_array(json_object('status',status,'count',n)) AS result FROM (SELECT status,COUNT(*) n FROM bookings GROUP BY status) UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox_status',json_group_array(json_object('status',status,'count',n)) FROM (SELECT status,COUNT(*) n FROM outbox GROUP BY status) UNION ALL SELECT 'confirmed_mismatches',CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)!=1 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)!=1 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id AND k.flight_id=b.flight_id AND k.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)!=1 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')!=1) UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sales',CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING COUNT(*)>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_mismatches',CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.charge_id=c.charge_id AND r.booking_id=b.booking_id AND r.amount_cents=c.amount_cents))) UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold_flights',CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity UNION ALL SELECT 'refunds',json_group_array(json_object('booking',booking_id,'charge',charge_id,'amount',amount_cents)) FROM refunds
